To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a MPC controller with on line linearisation can improve the performance of a greenhouse climate control system.
MPC is a powerful tool for controlling greenhouses and the MPC controller with on line linearisation outperforms the conventional PID controller.
a model predictive controller is a good alternative to control greenhouse climatic processes.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and implementation of a nonlinear model predictive controller which is capable of handling the non linearities of greenhouse climatic process and, at the time, provides a trade off between performance and computation burden.
the design, development and implementation of a Model Predictive Control system for greenhouses.
the application of a nonlinear model predictive control strategy to greenhouse climatic processes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of MPC with on line linearisation is a good choice to improve the performance of the greenhouse climate control system, and, consequently, to increase the productivity of greenhouse horticultural crops.
MPC can be considered as an attractive control approach for greenhouse climatic control systems.

the MPC strategy is able to provide the greenhouse operator with a powerful control tool, which is able to satisfy all the requirements imposed on the control system, while keeping the computational burden at a minimum level.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MPC strategy has been successfully applied to a greenhouse climate control system, providing a significant improvement in the control performance.
the MPC strategy is able to improve the greenhouse climatic control performance and, at the very least, to maintain the current level of performance.
the proposed MPC controller is able to achieve a satisfactory control of the greenhouse climatic processes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MPC is a powerful tool for greenhouse climate control.

MPC is an excellent candidate for controlling greenhouse climate processes, since the results obtained in the simulation study are very promising and the implementation of the control strategy is relatively simple.
the MPC controller can be implemented on a PC, which makes it a viable alternative to the PID controller.
